summary: Registers the application/smil and application/smil+xml media types for versions 1.0, 2.0 and 2.1 of the Synchronized Multimedia Integration Language. SMIL combines separate multimedia objects, such as video, audio and text, into one synchronized presentation. This is an informational memo.

eli5.summary: SMIL is like a script for a school play that says when the music starts, when the picture appears and when the words show up. This memo gives that script file its official name tag.
